title: Bottom mat reinforcement.
officialText:
In each direction, the bottom mat reinforcement shall be not less than, the steel
required for temperature reinforcement. The bottom mat reinforcement shall be anchored at discontinuous edges within the
column strip, reentrant corners, elevation changes and anywhere else the continuity of the reinforcing is interrupted.
Exception: Flat plate middle strip bottom mat reinforcing perpendicular to discontinuous slab edges. In addition, the
main bottom mat reinforcement in one-way slabs shall be anchored at discontinuous edges.
